state_rules.completion: COMPLETE requires accepted artifacts at exact source/config, verified criterion evidence, complete hard dependencies and SATISFIED completion decisions. Mere test count, generated files, mocks or agent agreement cannot complete a route.
state_rules.failure: Keep failed evidence and current working route; retire or reroute exact mechanism as source contract requires.
state_rules.successor: Preserve this snapshot; publish a successor with task ID, implementation revision, outcome/evidence and disposition. No future activity/actual cost is fabricated.
state_rules.decision_resolution: An ACTIVE resolver can bind resolution evidence and set SATISFIED before its own COMPLETE; resolving a decision never requires the resolver already COMPLETE.

Model fit/verify is implemented; fit replay, Q intervention, integrity, task/final candidate and pilot remain original Python protocol responsibilities.
Injected cache/chat and next counters do not yet have a native lifecycle owner or executable run that preserves budget across calls.

Direct module validateNativeS2SFitConfig(unknown) executes an enumerable seed getter and throws outside its Either error type.
Knowledge map and closure v5 retain OPEN/PARTIAL S5 states while final S5 result file and F1_R8 log mark the first-result deliverable complete.
Zero violations covers 297 top-level TS files under five pattern rules and 155 selected files under the AST guard; 38 documented exception files remain.
Native graph qualify intentionally executes uv/Python for Python runner profiles; bootstrap sync and mandatory math publishing compiler also remain Python.
Main-guard lexical catalog leaves 248 of 263 Python candidates unclassified; executable P1v4 scripts exist without observed current activation.
Opaque v5 local state-readout/remove/restore and real local Permit bridge do not supply one durable canonical revision plus genuinely held-out behavior run required by D4.
Finite conditional Lean models are actual formal progress but do not give one executable witness satisfying CR0-7 or integrated FCL1-8.

Inventory v8 mixes launchers, components, compatibility and experiments; 6 native and 16 partial entries do not define a migration percentage. Native watchdog is an offline judge dependent on upstream suite production.
